notes.title: Dec 7 bugfix
notes.notes: Ironed out the last bugs and crashes

notes.title: New feature: Challenge Mode
notes.notes:
Happy December, everyone! Thank you so much to everyone who has wishlisted the game and offered to beta test it! December 6th is right around the corner and I am very excited to release the game!

Inspired by this support, I added one last feature which wasn't in the beta: Challenge Mode!

Basically, you can focus purely on the combat in a series of increasingly tricky challenges, facing constantly growing hordes of tougher enemies, starting from the game's basic fodder and ending in endless waves of the toughest creatures in the game! Increase your score of every level and earn new achievements and master the game's weapons and power-ups.

Thanks for all your support and get ready for Entropy on December 6th!

- Alex, Scarabit Studio
